import copy,json,work
reqs=json.load(open('requests.json')); ev=json.load(open('evidence.json')); pol=json.load(open('policy.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json'))
expected=[{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['S1','X1'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']},{'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['D1'],'unknowns':[]}]
assert report==expected
assert [work.evaluate(r,ev,pol) for r in reqs]==expected
# Missing conditions, no evidence, verified filtering, withdrawal, supersession, canonical object agreement, and immutability.
r={'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}}; p={'required_conditions':['b','a'],'require_verified':True}; e=[{'source':'old','claim':'c','value':{'x':1,'y':[2]},'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True},{'source':'new','claim':'c','value':{'y':[2],'x':1},'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True,'supersedes':['old']},{'source':'u','claim':'c','value':9,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':False},{'source':'w','claim':'c','value':9,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True,'withdrawn':True}]
before=copy.deepcopy((r,e,p)); assert work.evaluate(r,e,p)=={'status':'supported','value':{'y':[2],'x':1},'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]}; assert (r,e,p)==before
assert work.evaluate({'claim':'c','conditions':{}},e,p)=={'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['a','b']}
assert work.evaluate({'claim':'absent','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}},e,p)=={'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']}
assert all(set(x)=={'status','value','sources','unknowns'} for x in report)
print('all checks passed')
